label: 0015 · Starter, 50 km BEL cut, remeshed BEL sheet with full prior (837 modes), UNR positions (exploratory MCMC)
description: starter_belcut50_remesh_unr with 837 BEL eigenmodes instead of 273. They keep 99% of the prior variance on the remeshed sheet, as 273 do on the first sheet, so the BEL prior is 0012's Matern field on a different mesh. The fit recovers fully, slightly better than 0012's (1.5% after Tohoku; with 273 modes it was 5% worse). Trench afterslip (Mw 8.39 at 2 yr), first-year afterslip in the main rupture (0.93 m), southwest Japan residuals and Nankai coupling are unchanged, so the results do not depend on how the BEL sheet is meshed: new Noto mesh, UNR IGS20 positions, same 596 GEONET sites and windows
